# 7. Excel Automation with Python

**Data:** synthetic (generated by `generate_sample_data.py`)

## Objective
Replace the manual task of opening six monthly branch files, fixing them by hand and copy-pasting them together. The script produces one clean, validated report and a log of everything it changed or rejected.

## Run it
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python generate_sample_data.py   # creates messy files in raw_data/
python consolidate.py            # writes output/consolidated_sales_report.xlsx and clean_sales.csv
```

## Problems in the raw files and how they are handled
| Problem | Handling |
|---------|----------|
| Different header names (`Inv No.`, `invoice_number`, `Total`...) | Alias table maps to standard names |
| Title rows above the header | Header row detected automatically |
| Blank rows | Skipped and counted |
| Trailing spaces, upper/lower case | Trimmed and mapped to standard values |
| Amounts as text (`₹12,500.00`) | Currency symbol and commas stripped, converted to numbers |
| Mixed date formats, invalid dates | Several formats tried; unparseable dates rejected |
| Unknown region, negative quantity, missing amount | Rejected with a reason |
| Duplicate invoice numbers across files | First kept, rest logged |
| Amount differs from qty x price | Kept but flagged `CHECK` |

## Control totals
For every file: rows read = blank + rejected + duplicates + clean. The script stops with an error if any file does not reconcile. The summary sheet also carries an Excel check formula comparing its grand total with the sum of `Clean_Data`.

## Output sheets
`Clean_Data`, `Summary_Month_Region`, `Summary_Product`, `File_Control_Totals`, `Data_Quality_Log`, `Rejected_Rows`.

## Result on the sample data
682 rows read (incl. 18 blank), 654 clean rows loaded, 6 rejected, 4 duplicates removed, 1 flagged, revenue INR 13,112,350.

## Power Query alternative (no code)
Data > Get Data > From Folder > Combine & Transform; promote headers, rename columns, set data types, remove duplicates, filter errors. The Python version adds the reject log and control totals.
